description: Connect approved Jira Cloud projects as Issue data sources and read-only assistant tools.

assistant_guidance.summary: Use Jira tools to search and inspect issues in approved Jira Cloud projects.
when_to_use: The user asks for current issue information from an approved Jira project.
The user asks to find issues by text or inspect one issue key.

topics.summary: Search issues within an approved project, then inspect a specific issue.
topics.details: Use the project scope selected by the Connection. Search results are bounded. Use jira_get_issue for a known issue key and jira_search_issues when the issue key is unknown.

email.title: Account email
email.description: Non-secret email paired with the Jira Cloud API Token.

secret_value.title: API Token
secret_value.description: A write-only Jira Cloud API Token with read access.

projects.title: Allowed projects
projects.description: Explicit Jira project keys this connection may access.

max_issues.title: Maximum issues
max_issues.description: Export up to 100 most recently updated Issues.

tools.description: Read one Issue from an approved Jira Cloud project.
Search Issues by text within one approved Jira Cloud project.
